title: feat(nm2frm2lxs): L-path cyclic-frame transport -e3 then -e1 at t+1 on two-axis same-lock seed: reverse HOLD, face fails
science: Bare L-path (-e3,-e1) on the two-axis SAME-lock seed. Same verdict pair as the opposite-lock seed but by a different route: same-lock destroys split at the face source (0,0,1), killing that first hop, whereas on the opposite seed the face failure is at the second hop.
